description: KNa₃Al₄Si₄O₁₆ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃ space group. K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 3.01-3.06 Å. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.56-2.90 Å. There are two inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.75 Å) and three longer (1.76 Å) Al-O bond lengths. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.74 Å) and three longer (1.76 Å) Al-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four AlO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.63 Å) and three longer (1.64 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four AlO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.62 Å) and three longer (1.64 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to three equivalent Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one K, one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Al, and one Si atom.
